title: Unstructured library analytics may be on
explanation: The unstructured library is reported to send a Scarf analytics ping by default, disabled by SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS or DO_NOT_TRACK. Only a third-party source confirms this, so the rule is low confidence until checked against upstream.

evidence.detail: unstructured 0.16.5 installed; not disabled in the image (none of DO_NOT_TRACK=1|true|yes|on, SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=1|true|yes|on)

fix: Set SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=true and DO_NOT_TRACK=true in the image environment.
